description: Monthly day-ahead (DAM) price history for an ERCOT settlement point, back to January 2020 where the node existed: average price, TB4 and TB2 battery spreads (top 4 or 2 hours minus bottom 4 or 2 hours of each day, a screening metric for storage arbitrage), maximum and minimum, negative-price hours, and hours over $100 and $1,000. Pro adds the full history with year-over-year change per month, an annual table with TB4 per MW-year, and a seasonality table (average by calendar month across years) so you can see Winter Storm Uri (February 2021), the summer 2023 heat, and how spreads have moved since. Pass a settlement_point (HB_HOUSTON, LZ_WEST, a resource node) or a location and the nearest resource node with history is used. Use for 'how have prices at this node changed', 'is the spread getting better or worse', 'what is the seasonal pattern', 'what happened to prices in Uri'. Day-ahead only: real-time 15-minute history starts 2026-09-05, see volatile_nodes. Free accounts get the last 12 months; Pro gets the full history, year-over-year, annual and seasonality tables.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

months.description: Number of most recent months to return. Default 12 free, all Pro. Max 12 free.

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point (hub HB_*, zone LZ_*, or resource node) instead of an address or lat/lng.

name: price_history
title: Monthly day-ahead price history by node since 2020
